policy: Opt-in only. A reporter appears only after explicit, recorded consent to be named. Handles only — no email addresses, internal IPs, tokens or other private data are ever published.
incentive: There is no bug bounty program. Reward budget is 0. Public recognition is the only incentive.
removal: Send a removal request to security@generalbots.org stating the handle or advisory ID. Acknowledgement within 3 business days; the credit is withdrawn from the live site within 5 business days and omitted from the next signed mirror publication. Previously published content-addressed bundles cannot be edited; see the incident-response runbook for the retirement path. No explanation is required.

entry_schema.handle: Public handle or name the reporter chose to be shown
entry_schema.date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date credit was granted
entry_schema.opt_in: true — recorded consent to be named; false entries must never be published
entry_schema.example: true for illustrative records that are not real people
